nodes.name: Electrochemical reduction to metallic Cu nanowires

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of NiFe-LDH
nodes.procedure: Nanosheet-like NiFe-layered double hydroxide (NiFe-LDH) were vertically electrodeposited on Cu_NW with Ni:Fe ratio of 0.95.

nodes.name: Phosphidation of NiFe-LDH
nodes.procedure: After typical low-temperature phosphidation treatment, interface-rich NiP2 - FeP2 with thickness around 10-12 nm was successfully grown on Cu_NW to get the NiP2 - FeP2 / Cu_NW / Cu_f heterostructure with distinct diffraction peaks ascribed to NiP2 (JCPDS 21-0590) and FeP2 (JCPDS 89-2261), consistent with EDS ratio between Ni to P and Fe to P.
